strings.jp:
敵が来るわ!
戦闘準備!
strings.en:
The enemy's coming!
Prepare for battle!

strings.jp:
悪く思わないでください…
…これも任務なんです……
strings.en:
Please don't think ill of me...
...This is my mission...

strings.jp:
くっ!　さすがレオンの妹…
やってくれるじゃない……!
strings.en:
Tch! Leon's sister, all
right... Not bad, are you...!

strings.jp:
どう?　降伏すれば
命だけは助けてあげるわよ?
strings.en:
Well? Surrender, and I'll
at least spare you, hmm?
